basic_profile.bio: I'm a sophomore at the University of Arkansas majoring in Computer Science. I recently got into survival and crafting games, with 'The Infected' being my current obsession. I love exploring new game mechanics and strategies. Besides gaming, I'm passionate about educational tools like mind mapping for organizing my studies. I live on campus and usually browse Reddit late at night or during study breaks. Currently single, I spend most of my time balancing gaming and coursework.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is primarily rooted in my Computer Science studies and my gaming hobby. I learned a lot about strategy and resource management through gaming communities and trial and error in various games. I also use mind mapping to organize my thoughts and study materials, which I discovered through an educational subreddit.
